fault_path.distinction_from_prior_probe: The prior witness injects anonymous backing calloc failure after VFileMemChunk has allocated its wrapper. This witness fails the earlier wrapper malloc itself; the pinned function returns NULL before calling anonymousMemoryMap or creating a VFile.
fault_path.source_contract: VFileMemChunk malloc failure returns NULL immediately. _GBACoreSavedataRestore checks the VFile result and returns false before dereferencing the core board or calling GBASavedataLoad/GBASavedataMask. This source caller path is not executed by the test.
fault_path.ownership_and_teardown: On successful construction, VFileMemChunk owns the backing allocation and wrapper; close frees both. On wrapper-malloc failure neither object exists, so there is no VFile close/unmap call to perform. The test verifies constructor-level cleanup only, not GBA caller or savedata teardown.
fault_path.logging: No logging path is executed or claimed; this constructor failure returns NULL.

caller_edge.result_contract: The wrapper-null branch returns false; true means only that wrapper construction reached the next operation, not that restore/load/mask succeeded.

nonexecuted_edges: src/gba/core.c::_GBACoreSavedataRestore was source-traced, not compiled or called.
No frontend logging, user-visible save result, gameplay, physical Flash, restart, or durability path was exercised.

allocation_wrappers.malloc: Fails exactly the next wrapped malloc request; rejects requests above 256 bytes; tested constructor path is the VFileMemChunk wrapper object.
allocation_wrappers.calloc: Observes positive-control backing allocation and rejects requests above 8 bytes; it does not inject calloc failure in this separate witness.
allocation_wrappers.free: Counts positive-control teardown frees while the probe is active.
